modelDescription: The Savage Arms AXIS II XP package rifle offers amazing out-of-the-box performance at an affordable price. It's flush with features aimed at delivering tack-driving accuracy on every shot, including the company's legendary, user-adjustable AccuTrigger system and a factory-mounted, bore-sighted Bushnell Banner 3-9x40mm scope. Added amenities include a button-rifled 22-inch barrel with a matte blued finish, silky smooth bolt action, detachable box magazine and thread-in barrel headspacing.
